reserveReview.rationale: Issuer materials describe VNDC 2.0 as backed by USDT/USDC collateral pools on BNB Smart Chain and Polygon, but they do not publish a current reserve split, dated attestation, or independently verified balance. The reserve and redemption claims therefore remain an issuer-disclosed aggregate under the existing investigation and withdrawal-risk notice.
